title: Экзокринная недостаточность поджелудочной железы
terminology: EPI is a syndrome of insufficient exocrine pancreatic enzyme secretion causing maldigestion, with possible secondary malabsorption.
Weight loss, stool volume, altered appetite, breed and pancreatic history create suspicion but do not replace species-specific serum TLI.
Ordinary lipase/amylase, ultrasound, stool appearance or response to an enzyme trial does not confirm EPI.
Canine and feline TLI retain species, assay, sample and reference-interval identity; external turnaround is not instant.
Cobalamin and folate are evaluated explicitly; cobalamin deficiency is a separate clinically important problem and poor-outcome factor.
Young breed-associated acinar atrophy and adult acquired chronic-pancreatic routes remain distinct, while breed only changes prior probability.
Feline EPI and atypical presentations require broad pancreatic, intestinal, endocrine and neoplastic comorbidity review.
Absence of polyphagia, obvious steatorrhea or overt diarrhea does not exclude an appropriate TLI route.
Poor response first triggers product, storage, meal, actual-use, cobalamin and diet audit before a refractory label.
Concurrent chronic enteropathy or dysbiosis requires evidence and does not create an automatic antimicrobial route.
Stable disease preserves TLI, cobalamin, pancreatic cause, actual management, weight/stool response and recurring supply burden longitudinally.
No enzyme, vitamin, diet, antimicrobial, drug, dose or schedule is generated.

commonHistoryQuestions.prompt: Как менялись weight, muscle condition, appetite и stool volume/frequency?
Каков diet, treats, scavenging и доступ к корму других животных?
Были ли pancreatitis, diabetes, abdominal surgery или pancreatic mass?
Как взят TLI, какой species assay, sample и reference interval?
Проверены ли cobalamin/folate, когда и в какой лаборатории?
Как product использовался с meals, хранился и что фактически получал пациент?
Есть ли vomiting, pain, anorexia, blood, fever или dehydration?
Как менялись weight, stool и appetite после каждого компонента?
Есть ли intestinal, parasite, endocrine или neoplastic evidence?
Менялись ли product batch, supply, storage или affordability?
Есть ли adverse effect, oral irritation или bleeding?
Каковы lifelong-plan, monitoring, red-flag и referral возможности?

sourceCatalog.title: Merck Veterinary Manual: Exocrine Pancreatic Insufficiency in Dogs and Cats
Merck Veterinary Manual: Malabsorption Syndromes in Small Animals

variants.title: Классическая мальдигестия у собаки
variants.diagnosticTruth: Classic canine weight loss, polyphagia and voluminous loose stool justify objective maldigestion assessment, species-specific serum TLI confirmation and cobalamin/folate testing; breed, age, stool appearance and prior pancreatic disease modify probability or cause but never replace TLI.

presentations.complaint: Progressive weight and muscle loss occurs despite polyphagia, with frequent voluminous loose stool.

historyAnswers.weight_muscle_appetite_stool_volume_freq: Serial weight/MCS, appetite and stool trend fixed.
historyAnswers.vomiting_pain_anorexia_blood_fever_dehyd: Red flags screened rather than attributed to EPI.
historyAnswers.tli_species_sample_reference_interval: No valid TLI yet or external result identity preserved.

examFindings.finding: Weight, appetite and stool are an objective baseline.

followUp.timing: after TLI/cobalamin result then same-scale weight/stool/appetite checkpoint

outcomes.safe: Classic suspicion is confirmed with species-specific evidence and deficiency mapping.
outcomes.unsafe: The textbook appearance directly activates EPI treatment.

ownerCommunication: Explain that the pattern is typical but a species-specific blood test must confirm pancreatic enzyme failure.

presentations.complaint: A young dog or predisposed breed has a pattern compatible with pancreatic acinar atrophy.

outcomes.safe: Breed informs suspicion while TLI and comorbidity evidence determine diagnosis.
outcomes.unsafe: A young predisposed dog is diagnosed by signalment.

ownerCommunication: Explain that breed risk changes likelihood but cannot replace TLI confirmation.

presentations.complaint: An adult dog develops maldigestion after chronic pancreatic disease, with possible diabetes or structural disease.

investigations.result: Pancreatitis, diabetes, mass and intestinal context.

outcomes.safe: EPI is confirmed while pancreatic cause and comorbidities remain visible.
outcomes.unsafe: A pancreatitis history automatically becomes EPI or hides active disease.

ownerCommunication: Explain that prior pancreatic damage makes EPI plausible but current function still needs TLI measurement.

variants.title: Кошачья или нетипичная подача
variants.diagnosticTruth: Feline and atypical EPI may lack textbook polyphagia, steatorrhea or overt diarrhea; appropriate species-specific TLI, cobalamin/folate and broad pancreatic/intestinal comorbidity review are required, while discordant low TLI is repeated or specialist-reviewed rather than forced into severe disease.

presentations.complaint: A cat has weight loss and loose or variable stool, often with chronic pancreatitis, intestinal disease, diabetes or another comorbidity.

historyAnswers.weight_muscle_appetite_stool_volume_freq: Feline weight/MCS and stool pattern fixed.

examFindings.finding: Colon reserve and comorbidity may mask textbook signs.

followUp.timing: feline TLI/cobalamin conclusion and comorbidity-specific response

outcomes.safe: Feline EPI is confirmed without requiring canine textbook signs.
outcomes.unsafe: A cat is excluded for no polyphagia or evaluated with canine reference logic.

ownerCommunication: Explain that cats often have subtler signs and more concurrent pancreatic or intestinal disease.

presentations.complaint: TLI is low or borderline while clinical signs are intermittent, mild or discordant with severe EPI.

historyAnswers.tli_species_sample_reference_interval: Species, assay, sample and exact interval fixed.
historyAnswers.weight_muscle_appetite_stool_volume_freq: Objective disease burden may be mild/intermittent.

examFindings.finding: Monitoring does not erase low TLI.

followUp.timing: repeat/specialist TLI interpretation and objective progression monitoring

outcomes.safe: Discordance stays visible and is resolved without invented severity.
outcomes.unsafe: Any low value turns into the same severe EPI case.

ownerCommunication: Explain why the laboratory result and current symptoms do not yet tell exactly the same story.

presentations.complaint: Chronic or intermittent diarrhea and weight loss occur without polyphagia, pale stool or obvious steatorrhea.

examFindings.finding: EPI is one branch, not default.

followUp.timing: TLI/mimic conclusion and same-scale GI/weight response

outcomes.safe: Nontextbook EPI remains testable while broader diarrhea causes stay active.
outcomes.unsafe: No pale stool or polyphagia falsely excludes EPI.

ownerCommunication: Explain that stool appearance is variable and the blood test answers the pancreatic-function question.

variants.title: Дефицит кобаламина или неполный ответ
variants.diagnosticTruth: Cobalamin deficiency is an explicit result and outcome modifier; poor response requires verification of original TLI, cobalamin, product, storage, meal linkage, actual use, diet, supply and adverse effects before concurrent enteropathy, dysbiosis or another mimic is assigned or referred.

presentations.complaint: Confirmed EPI has severe cobalamin deficiency with poor weight gain or persistent clinical burden.

historyAnswers.cobalamin_folate_results_and_timing: Exact result, timing and lab preserved.

examFindings.finding: It is not hidden inside generic EPI.

followUp.timing: cobalamin and same-scale weight/stool response checkpoints

outcomes.safe: Deficiency and overall EPI response are tracked separately and together.
outcomes.unsafe: Cobalamin is omitted or poor gain triggers random product escalation.

ownerCommunication: Explain that vitamin deficiency can prevent recovery even when pancreatic replacement is being used.

presentations.complaint: Diarrhea persists despite reported enzyme use, requiring a neutral actual-use and product audit before calling the case refractory.

historyAnswers.enzyme_product_meal_storage_and_actual_u: Product, storage, every meal and actual administration reconstructed.
historyAnswers.product_batch_supply_and_cost_continuity: Batch, supply gap and affordability fixed.

examFindings.finding: No owner blame; observed process is audited.
A correctable delivery problem remains separate.

followUp.timing: after one corrected delivery variable and objective response checkpoint

outcomes.safe: Correctable delivery problems are found before expensive refractory workup.
outcomes.unsafe: The owner is blamed or therapy is escalated without observing actual use.

ownerCommunication: Use teach-back and containers to reconstruct the process without framing gaps as personal failure.

presentations.complaint: Persistent signs after confirmed EPI and verified management raise chronic enteropathy, dysbiosis, parasitic, endocrine, neoplastic or other concurrent disease.

examFindings.finding: Original EPI remains while additional disease is investigated.

followUp.timing: concurrent-disease result and separated EPI/GI response checkpoints

outcomes.safe: Concurrent disease is evidenced without overwriting confirmed EPI.
outcomes.unsafe: Every incomplete response becomes dysbiosis and automatic antibiotics.

ownerCommunication: Explain that EPI can be real and well treated while a second intestinal problem still causes symptoms.

variants.title: Продольное ведение подтверждённой EPI
variants.diagnosticTruth: Confirmed EPI is usually a lifelong longitudinal condition: TLI, cobalamin, cause, weight/condition/stool/appetite response, actual management, adverse effects, supply/batch and comorbidity surveillance persist across visits; relapse is audited in the same patient before repeat testing or escalation.

presentations.complaint: Early follow-up measures weight, body/muscle condition, stool and appetite after a reviewed EPI plan begins.

examFindings.finding: Treatment response is not retroactive diagnosis.

followUp.timing: early objective checkpoint then individualized lifelong cadence

outcomes.safe: Early benefit and remaining deficits are measured and auditable.
outcomes.unsafe: Subjective improvement retroactively replaces TLI or ends monitoring.

ownerCommunication: Show the baseline and current weight/stool measures and identify the next safety target.

presentations.complaint: A previously controlled patient relapses after a supply, batch, storage, meal, diet or household-use change.

historyAnswers.prior_weight_stool_and_appetite_response: Prior remission and relapse remain same patient.

examFindings.finding: Low-cost causal audit first when safe.

followUp.timing: after corrected relapse factor and objective recovery checkpoint

outcomes.safe: Relapse is causally audited within the original disease trajectory.
outcomes.unsafe: The patient is regenerated or undergoes repeated testing before a simple process review.

ownerCommunication: Review the change neutrally and separate supply-system failure from personal blame.

presentations.complaint: A stable EPI patient continues lifelong supply, response and cobalamin monitoring with surveillance for diabetes, pancreatitis and intestinal disease.

historyAnswers.owner_home_plan_and_referral_feasibility: Red-flag plan and referral access reviewed.

examFindings.finding: Stability is not absence of ongoing needs.

followUp.timing: individual lifelong cadence with event-triggered comorbidity review

outcomes.safe: Stable care remains sustainable, measurable and connected to comorbidity alerts.
outcomes.unsafe: The game forgets prior results or generates one universal lifelong schedule.

ownerCommunication: Acknowledge the recurring cost and identify supply and symptom changes that should trigger contact.

familyValidationRules: Reject if breed, stool appearance, low weight, ordinary lipase/amylase, ultrasound or treatment response alone confirms EPI.
Reject if canine and feline TLI lose species/reference identity or external results are instant.
Reject if cobalamin/folate are omitted or a poor response skips actual-use, storage, meal and product audit.
Reject if every poor response becomes dysbiosis or an automatic antimicrobial route.
Reject if a stable lifelong patient loses prior TLI, cobalamin, cause or response after reload.
Reject if code generates enzyme, vitamin, diet, antimicrobial, drug, dose or schedule.
